questions.prompt: Why did Fancy say no to Bouncy's offer?
choices: She thought bouncing would not be gentle.
She wanted Bouncy to bend the sail more.
She had already straightened the sail.
questions.answer: She thought bouncing would not be gentle.
questions.rationale: Fancy says, "That is not what gently means," after Bouncy offers to bounce on the sail, which shows that she thought bouncing would not be gentle.
questions.evidenceText: Bouncy offered to bounce on it gently. That is not what gently means, said Fancy.

questions.prompt: How did Wiggly straighten the sail?
choices: He dampened and pressed it softly.
He sat on it with Chompy.
questions.answer: He dampened and pressed it softly.
questions.evidenceText: Wiggly dampened the sail gently and pressed it very softly. Slowly, slowly, it began to straighten.
